home.title: AccessPoint — Networking & Infrastructure Wholesale
home.desc: AccessPoint is an Eastern European wholesale networking distributor, with WLAN, antennas, structured cabling, fiber optics, racks, and smart home products — with brands like Ubiquiti, MikroTik, Teltonika, and Cambium Networks.
home.text: WEBSHOP → B2B wholesale — for installers and system integrators The soul of the network . We are official distributors and wholesalers for wired and wireless data transmission equipment. Find switches, Wi-Fi and P2P radio backhaul, structured cabling, fiber optics, power supplies, racks, security equipment and smart home devices — all in one place. Our featured brands include Ubiquiti, MikroTik, Cambium, Teltonika, CCS Cabling, Belden, Bitner, and FormRack.
